invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null TiledMap instance, based on construction and return flow.
The fileName is resolved and used to load a file, so it should not be null or empty.
The parameter argument is dereferenced for field access (parameter.generateMipMaps), so it cannot be null at this point.
The method explicitly builds and returns an instance of TiledMap.
The TiledMap result is set with a non-empty array of texture resources before returning.
